date_note: Hotel Dive says the sign-in issues happened on Tuesday, 17 November; Skift's same-day article gives the 9:15 a.m. ET start of complaints.
exec: Sign-in disruption at a major hotel group; the company says it was resolved the same day and found no indication it was cybersecurity-related.

evidence.quote: Downdetector first began receiving complaints about login issues from users around 9:15 am ET

plain: Marriott customers had trouble signing in to the website and app on the morning of November 17. Marriott says the problem was fixed the same day and its review found no sign it was cybersecurity-related.
summary: Sign-in to Marriott.com and the Bonvoy app failed on November 17; Skift says Downdetector complaints began around 9:15 a.m. ET (NewsNation gives about 9:46 a.m.). A Marriott spokesperson told Hotel Dive the issue was resolved the same day with help from its technology partners and that its review found no indication the disruption was cybersecurity-related. No further cause was given.
title: Marriott.com and Bonvoy app sign-ins disrupted; Marriott says resolved the same day

validation.note: NewsNation, Hotel Dive and Skift each report the sign-in disruption; Hotel Dive quotes Marriott's own statement. Skift article partly paywalled; timing from its readable text.

review.note: Fox says Marriott stated the sign-in disruption was resolved and found no cyber indication; sources give no 'hundreds' count or 9:17 time (Yahoo: 9:46 a.m.). Summary, plain and exec rewritten.
